additional_info.subject: From RC
additional_info.body:
During commissioning, the OCPP router was not accessible. A reset to factory settings and a new setup was also unsuccessful. Ramona Hilse has brought a new router from Hamburg. After several attempts, the Charger was handed over to the customer late in the evening. Please update the charger to FW 4.0.11. An update is possible daily from 11am to 2pm CET
On 20.8 at 19:10 we tried to load an e-truck from the Terberg company. The vehicle connected to the SICHARGE D, but the charging process did not start. The company
Terberg would adapt her communication and would like to have our logs from SICHARGE D for this. Can you provide me with these
